findings.message: Recovery treats transition.sourceCommit as a valid produced target for every strategy. Only fast-forward may end at sourceCommit; merge-commit and cherry-pick require an exact observed postState commit or separate trusted produced-commit evidence.

The claimed crash-after-effect fixture throws without changing the target. Add a real prepared-only crash window whose simulated target observation changes, then prove zero duplicate effect calls and strategy-aware recovered versus needs-reconciliation outcomes.
